Historical source check, 5 November 2026. This dated check describes the former Summer’s End kit, before the current Queen and Spot changes. Saved Wiki observations from 1–2 November are supplemented by 21 timestamped browser page captures on 5 November; this is not an in-game check. Eight base items had retained revision links. New receipts for Earth and Sky, the Cord and the Quiver bring that to eleven of fourteen; the Pendant, Compass and level-36 cloak still lack revision receipts in that dated audit. The selected BASIC recipebuild decision · A-074

Use The Queen of Rot with the selected Nearly Complete: Insightful Constitution +7, and put Diamond of Spot +22 (Colorless augment, ML36) in the Green socket on Legendary Ring of Unnatural Accuracy. Keep the Resistance +12 augment even though the model uses the Queen’s native +13 instead. Calamitous and Sinew remain the two bow options above; offhand stays empty.

Slots and levels. There are 33 sockets: 24 ordinary + 9 Sun/Moon; 28 filled. The five empty ordinary sockets are Compass Colorless, Queen Yellow, Claws Green, Coldlight Colorless and Battlerager Green. Every Solar and Lunar Gem in the table is the Legendary version. The nine Solar and Lunar Gems, Viktranium crafts, Nearly Complete and Sealed in Undeath are separate fills, not innate finished-item effects. Both filled bows and the complete outfit require level 36. The quiver has no sockets. Spot +22 is a Competence source; it does not promise a final +22 skill increase or a successful trap check. Its acquisition route is unknown; no vendor is assumed.

Source limits. The Queen’s ML35, binding, sockets, named effects and explicit Insightful Constitution +7 option were relayed from a normal Wiki page observation around 00:07 UTC on 9 November 2026. The reported footer was 19 September 2026, Update 81.3, with logged-out caching up to 12 hours. Original capture bytes, an exact revision permalink and every tooltip bonus type were not retained here. Acquisition and quest-pack routes use retained infobox harvests; not every quest page was freshly opened. The A-074 record distinguishes that relay, prior retained item evidence and the study report; none is a new local optimizer run or an in-game check.
